task_name: Shared helpers — status labels, period window, favorite aggregation

strengths: Pure helpers with no fetch, store, or React import
toOutletStatus maps 6 canonical + Canceled alias, escapes and truncates unknown to 20 chars with tooltip Lainnya
periodWindow uses N calendar dates inclusive (today-(N-1)) with Asia/Jakarta 00:00 start as exact UTC instants; 7/30/90 all exact
topFavorites keys by product_id, sums integer qty, most-recent display name, skips null product_id, fallback Produk #id, tie-break name asc
